intro_html: All the flavor of stuffed peppers without the fuss of stuffing a single one. This skillet delivers 46 grams of protein per bowl for about $5.31 (at everyday cost) and makes 14 servings. You get the same savory beef, pepper, and rice combo, just faster and built for meal prep.
cost_closing_html: About $5.31 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 bowls serves 46 grams of protein at 594 calories, so this shortcut version loses none of the substance.
upsell_html: Stuffed pepper taste with half the work and a fraction of the cost. Work smarter, eat better. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Chopping the peppers into the skillet means you can buy the cheaper loose green peppers instead of hunting for pretty ones to stuff.
Reduced-fat mozzarella melts beautifully and trims the fat, and one bag covers the whole batch.
Simmering the rice in the beef broth builds flavor for free instead of buying seasoned rice mixes.
make_it: Brown 4.9 pounds of 93/7 ground beef with the chopped onion and green bell peppers, then drain.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, beef broth, garlic, and italian seasoning.
Cook the rice separately, or simmer it right in the skillet with the broth until tender.
Let everything simmer together so the rice soaks up the tomato and pepper flavor.
Melt the reduced-fat mozzarella over the top before you portion it out.

head.description: A high-protein American meal prep. Fourteen servings at about 594 calories and 46 grams of protein for roughly $5.31 each (at everyday cost).
